name: Otomaco: Last Jade Journey
summary: Otomaco: Last Jade Journey is a point-and-click adventure game set in a fantastical world. Three travelers from the Asauri Valley are searching for the legendary city of Otomaco. Each of them wants to find a different treasure. The Ork Gheri dreams about Otaxi, the magic shield. The monk, Zeng, is looking for the lost papyrus from the god Olitec's temple. The Elf Elanti has not revealed what he is seeking...perhaps you can find out?
